Duplicate queue census now proves exactly one canonical legacy queue record for the stable task_id + attempt_id + idempotency_key identity.
The legacy queue is explicitly treated as predating continuation_key; continuation remains mandatory on request/current-task/receipt rather than being falsely required in the legacy queue.
git grep treeish results are normalized from HEAD:path before duplicate-census comparison.
Coordinator receipt is limited to 600 seconds and binds request/current-task/queue Git blobs.
Coordinator receipt binds SHA-256 of 043/045/044/042/041 runtime preflight outputs.
Receipt binding key covers stable identity, continuation, three Git blobs, runtime HEAD, five preflight hashes and effective 039/040 entrypoints.
039 runs 046 with the already validated Git executable immediately before strict measurement.
Queue root and heartbeat inputs are snapshot-only tracked inputs so unrelated worktree writes do not create false dirty-worktree blockers.
